Giles is tracking the Southern Resident killer whales, an endangered species whose population recovery is faltering despite years of protection. In their search for their dwindling food source, the whales are spending less time in the Salish Sea, the maze of inland waters between Washington State and British Columbia. But in the last half-decade, the orcas have been hunting coho and chum salmon just north of Seattle during the fall. items.title: Signers of the Declaration of Independence
items.excerpt: Born on April 13, 1743, near present-day Charlottesville, Virginia, Thomas Jefferson was the primary drafter of the Declaration of Independence and the third President of the United States. The son of Peter Jefferson, a farmer and surveyor, and Jane Randolph, who hailed from a prominent Virginia family, Jefferson was educated by private tutors. He later attended the College of William and Mary, where he studied mathematics, philosophy, law, and languages. A man of the Enlightenment, he inherited a large estate from his father and designed his lifelong residence, Monticello. At 26, Jefferson entered the Virginia House of Burgesses, where his eloquence earned him a seat in the Second Continental Congress. items.description: Major chains and food companies are trying new products targeted at GLP-1 users, estimated at about 11% of the U.S. population.
items.excerpt: As millions of Americans take GLP-1 drugs for weight loss , food and beverage companies are working hard to keep up with their changing tastes . Nearly every major chain is trying new products targeted at GLP-1 users, estimated at about 11% of the U.S. population — or around 30 million people.
